summary: Behavior change: a picked mention is sent with its canonical label. Ordinary labels (also emoji, flags, Persian, Devanagari) stay byte-identical; hidden characters, { } <! -->, line breaks and over 120 code points change; an invalid type or id is sent as @label without a marker.
howTo: Nothing to do for the new default. What changes: { } <! --> --!> become ｛ ｝ ‹! --› --!›; control, line/paragraph separators and whitespace runs one space; format characters (bidi, zero-width space, word joiner, BOM, soft hyphen, other Cf), variation selectors, U+034F, Hangul fillers, U+2800, private use, unassigned/noncharacters and lone surrogates are removed, except one ZWJ between emoji, one ZWJ/ZWNJ between letters, the England/Scotland/Wales flag tags and one VS15/VS16 after an emoji-capable character; NFC; over 120 code points cut to at most 119 and …. A mention whose type is not [a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63} (capitals, non-ASCII) or whose id has : { } < >, whitespace, control, format or invisible characters or over 200 UTF-16 units is sent as prefix and label without a marker, so the model loses the id (legacy mentions config, addActiveMention, addMention/insertMention/setValue with app-built mentions, stored drafts and queue items; ids also from completion items). Stored older text is read as before. An app that needs the old format sets mentions: { serialize: { labels: 'raw' } }; maxLabelLength (1-120) cuts shorter. See docs/chat-interactions.md, Mention markers.
